records.technical_description: Community corrected first-wave dynamics: explicit position derivative, net force and acceleration solve under positive constant mass and stated kinematic assumptions.
records.plain_description: Find motion rate, net force and acceleration for a positive constant mass under the stated motion assumptions.

records.technical_description: Compute Langmuir coverage, occupied and vacant site densities and common equilibrium event rate from kinetic coefficients. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find the fraction of occupied surface sites, occupied and empty site densities, and the shared equilibrium event rate from the supplied adsorption and release rates under the stated surface model.

records.technical_description: Compute endpoint kinetic energies and signed net translational work from constant mass and signed 1D velocities, with exact arithmetic and reviewed seven-step source proof. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find starting and ending motion energy and the signed net work between them for a constant mass moving along one axis.

records.technical_description: Compute ideal level-ground projectile flight time, horizontal range and global maximum range at fixed launch speed. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find flight time, horizontal distance and the greatest possible distance at a fixed launch speed for ideal motion landing at its launch height.

records.technical_description: Compute normalized finite-dimensional Hermitian expectation from an operator and nonzero pure state. Reconstructed adjoint proof and exact converted-input rational arithmetic. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find the normalized average value of a finite Hermitian operator in a nonzero pure state, using exact arithmetic for the converted inputs.

records.technical_description: Construct symbolic vector vacuum wave-equation sides and separate Gauss divergence constraint from arbitrary C2 Cartesian electric fields. Reviewed six-step Maxwell derivation and corrected SI dimensions. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Build the two sides of the electric-field wave equation in empty space and a separate check of its divergence condition. Accept sufficiently smooth Cartesian fields without assuming they solve the equations.

records.technical_description: Compute the local temperature derivative of internal energy at fixed pressure from Cv, internal pressure, volume and expansion. Corrected pressure dimensions and explicit differential chain rule. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find how internal energy changes with temperature at fixed pressure from heat capacity, internal pressure, volume and thermal expansion.

records.technical_description: Compute normalized finite-distribution mean and population variance using exact converted-input arithmetic. Corrected source expectation identity. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find the mean and population variance of a finite probability distribution after normalization, using exact arithmetic for the converted inputs.

records.technical_description: Compute Brewster incidence and complementary refraction angles with corrected incident/transmitted ratio and independent rounding. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find the incidence angle for the stated Brewster condition and its complementary refraction angle using the corrected ratio of incident and transmitted refractive indices.

records.technical_description: Compute positive Lorentz factor and transformed event time and spatial coordinates for a standard inertial x-axis boost. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Convert an event time and position between inertial frames moving relative to each other along the x axis, using the positive Lorentz factor.

records.technical_description: Evaluate sin(2*x) through the product identity for real radians. All six source derivation steps verified under exact imaginary-unit interpretation. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find the sine of twice a real angle in radians using the double-angle product identity.

records.technical_description: Compute radial infall speed, inward velocity, gravitational work and potential from rest at infinity in a fixed central field. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find inward speed, signed inward velocity, gravitational work and potential for ideal radial fall from rest at infinity toward a fixed central source.

records.technical_description: Construct general real-angle Euler formula and branch-free ODE proof certificate with input specialization. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Build the relation between a complex exponential and sine and cosine for a real angle, together with a checkable differential-equation proof.

records.technical_description: Compute constant-force position, velocity, kinetic and potential energy, conserved total energy and signed work. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find position, velocity, motion energy, potential energy, total energy and signed work for motion under a constant force.

records.technical_description: Compute natural frequency and full released-from-rest spring displacement, velocity and acceleration. Corrected source square root; automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find natural frequency, displacement, velocity and acceleration for the stated ideal spring and mass released from rest.

records.technical_description: Convert a positive finite cycle duration in seconds to ordinary frequency in hertz. Preserves scalar or array shape; does not estimate period or calculate angular frequency.
records.plain_description: Convert a positive finite cycle duration in seconds to cycles per second. Preserve input shape; this does not estimate a cycle duration or return angular frequency.

records.technical_description: Evaluate assumed Newtonian force magnitude, both acceleration magnitudes and interaction potential energy. Source inference gaps retained; automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find force magnitude, each acceleration magnitude and interaction potential energy under the assumed Newtonian gravity model. The retained source inference limits still apply.

records.technical_description: Compute ideal escape speed and required launch energy using the approved infall provider, retaining an explicitly labeled inward counterpart. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find ideal escape speed and the launch energy needed in the stated gravity model. Also return an explicitly labeled inward-fall counterpart.

records.technical_description: Construct sine-squared and half-angle expressions with full source reconstruction and independent endpoint certificate. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Build equivalent sine-squared and half-angle expressions with a checkable symbolic certificate.

records.technical_description: Infer Newtonian spherical-source mass from gravitational acceleration, radius and G, with exact arithmetic and corrected source-example evaluation. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Infer the mass of a spherical gravity source from gravitational acceleration, radius and the supplied gravitational constant.

records.technical_description: Solve a real quadratic with both ordered roots using an explicitly corrected proof. Exact float64 discriminant classification and high-precision stable root evaluation. Automated Tier 3; no source-parity claim.
records.plain_description: Find both ordered roots of a real quadratic using a corrected derivation, exact classification of the converted discriminant and stable high-precision evaluation.

records.technical_description: Compute signed final velocity, displacement and average velocity for constant acceleration, including zero time and reversal. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find signed final velocity, displacement and average velocity for constant acceleration, including zero elapsed time and direction reversal.

records.technical_description: Compute equivalent resistance of two nonnegative ohmic resistors in series, with a nonzero common-current guard. Returns resistance in ohms; finite scalar or broadcastable array inputs.
records.plain_description: Add the resistance of two ideal resistors connected in series. Resistances must be nonnegative and the common current must be nonzero. Return ohms for a single input or compatible arrays.

records.technical_description: Compute circular Newtonian two-body period from positive SI separation, both masses and explicit G. Corrected source derivation with stable high-precision evaluation. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find the period of a circular Newtonian two-body orbit from separation, both masses and an explicit gravitational constant in SI units.

records.technical_description: Compute normalized two-wave fixed-phase intensity, incoherent mean, constructive and destructive extrema, interference cross term and ratio. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find the combined intensity of two waves at fixed relative phase, their incoherent mean, maximum and minimum intensity, cross term and ratio under the stated normalization.

records.technical_description: Evaluate corrected ideal-projectile elapsed time and height at a horizontal coordinate. Exact converted-input arithmetic and reviewed time-elimination proof. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find elapsed time and height at a horizontal position for the stated ideal projectile model.

records.technical_description: Construct both sine and cosine exponential representations with checked Euler premise and linear-system certificate. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Build sine and cosine from complex exponentials with a checked Euler premise and a checkable linear-equation certificate.

records.technical_description: Construct symbolic Cartesian curl-curl, gradient of divergence and component Laplacian for general C2 vector fields. Corrected Levi-Civita contraction verified exhaustively. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Build the curl of the curl, the gradient of divergence and the component Laplacian for a sufficiently smooth Cartesian vector field, with the corrected symbolic identity.

records.technical_description: Evaluate the fixed exact Euler identity at pi and return its symbolic proof certificate. Automated Tier 3 with explicit reviewed constant interpretation; no literal source-AST parity claim.
records.plain_description: Evaluate the exact Euler identity at pi and return its symbolic proof under the reviewed interpretation of the constants.

records.technical_description: Compute real 3D recoil momentum and its squared Euclidean norm from two momentum vectors. Explicitly reconstructed source proof; exact rational arithmetic before float64 rounding. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find the recoil momentum vector and its squared length from two real three-dimensional momentum vectors.

records.technical_description: Compute full signed projectile position and velocity at elapsed time for arbitrary launch direction under constant downward gravity. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find signed position and velocity at an elapsed time for ideal projectile motion with any launch direction and constant downward gravity.

records.technical_description: Compute center-based orbital radius and circular speed from explicit G, central mass and period under the test-mass model. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find the radius measured from the center and circular speed from a central mass, period and gravitational constant, treating the orbiting mass as negligible.

records.technical_description: Construct a full three-dimensional free-particle wave, energy, gradient, Laplacian, time derivative and checkable Hamiltonian certificate. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Build a three-dimensional free-particle wave, its energy and spatial and time derivatives, with a checkable certificate for the governing equation.

records.technical_description: Compute circular-path circumference and average speed from radius and period, including reviewed source example with exact unit conversion. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find the circumference and average speed of circular motion from its radius and period, with explicit unit conversion.

records.technical_description: Construct six hyperbolic and imaginary-argument function forms, eighteen identities and a self-contained exponential-definition certificate. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Build six hyperbolic and imaginary-angle function forms and eighteen identities, with a certificate based on exponential definitions.

records.technical_description: Compute equivalent resistance, two branch currents and total current for ideal parallel resistors with signed common voltage, including zero. Automated Tier3.
records.plain_description: Find equivalent resistance, each branch current and total current for two ideal parallel resistors at a shared signed voltage, including zero voltage.

records.technical_description: Evaluate the ideal-gas volumetric isobaric expansion coefficient from absolute temperature. Reviewed five-step derivation, molar amount dimensions and restored intermediate denominator. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find the fractional volume change per temperature change for an ideal gas held at fixed pressure, using absolute temperature.

records.technical_description: Verify exact Hermitian eigenstates and compute complex overlap, matrix element and eigenvalue-gap product, retaining degenerate nonzero overlap. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Check exact eigenstates of a Hermitian operator and find their complex overlap, matrix element and eigenvalue-gap product. Equal eigenvalues can retain nonzero overlap.

records.technical_description: Compute corrected conditional sound-speed scaling, its A=1 scale, and prefactor/shear diagnostics. No universal material-speed bound claim; automated Tier3.

records.technical_description: Evaluate ideal-gas isothermal volume compressibility from absolute pressure. Reviewed six-step derivative proof, molar amount and inverse-pressure dimensions. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find how an ideal gas volume responds fractionally to pressure changes at fixed temperature, using absolute pressure.

records.technical_description: Compute all four periodic-wave parameters from ordinary frequency and phase-speed magnitude, with explicit angular conventions and reviewed six-step source proof. Automated Tier 3.
records.plain_description: Find the four periodic-wave parameters from cycles per second and phase-speed magnitude using explicit angular conventions.

records.technical_description: Construct normalized Dirichlet interval modes with both global-sign representatives, wavenumber, spatial derivatives and boundary/normalization certificate. Automated Tier3.

records.technical_description: Construct time-harmonic vector field, spatial Laplacian and Helmholtz residual with exact symbolic derivatives. Preserve non-solutions and zero frequency. Automated Tier 3.
